kjv: Though Israel be not gathered, yet shall I be glorious
mine: that Israel might be gathered to him—for I am honored
note: The ketiv lo' "not" gives the KJV's "though Israel be not gathered"; the qere lo "to him" (and 1QIsa-a) gives "that Israel might be gathered to him", parallel to "bring Jacob back to him".
MT sinim is unknown; the Dead Sea Isaiah scroll reads swnyym, i.e. Syene (Aswan) in southern Egypt, where there was a Jewish colony. "Sinim" was once popularly taken as China.
